ownerTask.objective: Retrieve the current asOfGameTimeMs from the authorized self-scoped pact_world_read_v1 result with forecastMinutes 60. Report the exact observed value through requestedFacts. Inspect schema only if needed. Do not infer elapsed time, change state, contact peers, or claim a read completed before its result. If the read is unavailable or cannot complete within the bounded allowance, return the existing honest unresolved result.
ownerTask.success: One matching native read returns the requested fact, followed by the canonical known-fact wait summary with exactly that value; no action intent, message, persistent goal change or additional task.
ownerTask.safeIncomplete: Native unresolved wait summary, without a fabricated value or delivery claim; record as incomplete, not a task success.

futureRehearsalLimits.deadlineRule: Freeze an absolute UTC deadline and exact fresh fixture identities before separately approving any rehearsal. No deadline or execution grant is issued by this proposal.

executionBoundary.actionIntentPolicy: Reject before persistence or dispatch; omit all executable game-command ports. This boundary must be proven offline before a model rehearsal.
executionBoundary.taskStatePolicy: Use isolated fixture/memory only; no installed goal, identity, allocation, queue or schedule changes.

activationGaps: No authenticated owner/entity binding has been selected; example entity ID is synthetic and must never be submitted as an existing actor.
No real operator fact request or specialist profile is configured in the installed console.
A fresh fixture rehearsal must prove native adapter observation -> v3 engine -> canonical final with no executable action port.
Native preset includes resources and diplomacy; the proposal does not remove or rewrite native charters. One-shot routing and zero-action enforcement need explicit fixture proof.
The native budget minimum of one action is not zero-action enforcement; runtime/harness denial is independently required.
No existing actor roster, actual deadline, launch spec, launch draft or activation grant is created.
Prove native adapter packet fit within 13000 bytes and account for bootstrap reads/catalog calls; do not silently raise limits or enable continuity/discovery reads.
